# Meaco Greece | Sani Hellas — Official Meaco UK Representative in Greece

> SANI HELLAS AE is the exclusive official representative of Meaco UK dehumidifiers, fans and air-treatment products in Greece since 2011. Based in Athens (Nea Chalkidona), we supply the full Meaco range with official Greek warranty and after-sales support. Product categories: desiccant (zeolite) dehumidifiers, compressor dehumidifiers with HEPA air purification, ultra-quiet DC fans, and spare filters. Contact: tel. 210 3236627, sales@meaco.gr.

## Selection Guide

- Heated rooms above ~18°C: choose a compressor model (Arete Two).
- Unheated spaces, basements, winter use: choose a desiccant model (DD8L / DD8L Pro), which work from 1°C.
- Note: rated extraction (e.g. 20L/day) is measured at 30°C/80% RH. In typical Greek conditions (18-22°C, 60-70% RH) real-world output is materially lower.
